title: compact incident briefs and auto-repro hints
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: on-call rotations increasingly get paged with high-noise alerts where the initial triage cost is dominated by creating a minimal, actionable brief and an immediate reproducer hint. This PR introduces a compact incident brief format with prioritized relevance scoring and a lightweight auto-repro hint generator that surfaces the smallest set of signals required to start reproducing or assessing impact.

What this does: - Adds a new 'compact-brief' serializer used by the incident-bot summary flow; the serializer reduces payload size and highlights 1) top 3 affected services, 2) likely root cause indicators (metric spikes, recent deploys), 3) 30s timeline, 4) quick mitigations and rollback hints. - Implements a heuristic-driven "auto-repro-hint" module that inspects traces, recent CI failures, and infra change events to output short reproduction recipes (shell commands, curl examples, sequence of interactions) or a deterministic list of dataset/query inputs. - Exposes a new brief-type option on the /api/v1/incidents POST endpoint so callers can request compact briefs for noisy channels (PagerDuty, Slack digest). - Adds config toggles for SRE teams to control how verbose reproducer hints may be (allowing opt-out for sensitive incidents).

Checklist: - [x] implement compact serializer and sample templates - [x] implement auto-repro-hint heuristics (metric correlator + deploy correlate + trace shortener) - [x] API param and validation + feature flag - [x] unit tests for serializer and hint generator - [x] integration test through staged incident example harness - [x] docs: incident-bot runbook entry and quickstart snippet - [x] feature gating and audit log entries for sensitive hints

Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged unless callers pass brief_type=compact. Existing consumers continue to receive the full, verbose brief. Briefs include a metadata flag indicating presence of reproducer hints so downstream UIs can hide them for sensitive channels.

Security and privacy: reproducer hints default to redact any full secrets and will not include raw partial PII by default. We added an audit log entry for each generated hint with hashing applied and KMS-encrypted pointers for teams using Private mode.

Testing & verification: ran integration harness with 5 synthetic incidents that previously required >12 minutes to triage down to ~3 minutes with compact briefs. CI includes a new e2e scenario that exercises the full brief+hint pipeline.

Notes: this is intentionally conservative; the heuristics are pluggable and the module implements a strict allowlist for the types of commands that can be suggested. Future work: add model-backed hint ranking and a feedback loop that demotes hints flagged by oncall responders.

Evan Brooks: Integration tests flaked once due to timing on trace shortening logic — increased debounce window and added retry in harness. All green on re-run.
